## VMC Ubbink Ubiflux Vigor — v1.3.1

Patch release adding the **W450** to the Model option introduced in v1.3.0.

### New
- **Model** now offers `W450` (Airflow Rate range 75–450 m³/h), alongside W225 (40–225), W325 (50–325), W400 (50–400) and W600 (100–600). The range comes from the Ubbink W450 installation manual; the unit shares the control board and the Modbus register map of the other Vigor models.

Thanks to @PolDeLepel for pointing out the missing model.

Issue: [#31](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/issues/31). Change: [#34](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/pull/34).

### Upgrade
Update to v1.3.1 through HACS and restart Home Assistant. W450 owners then pick their model under **Settings → Devices & services → VMC Ubbink → Configure**; other installs need no changes.
